::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bhubaneswar startup incubated at KIIT-TBI designing silicon-photonics integrated circuits for gas sensing; supported through the Chips-DLI programme (not among the 24 PDLI projects). Earlier listed in this tracker under the incorrect name 'Qualivor'.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Silicon-photonics (PIC) single- and multi-gas sensor chips for industrial and environmental monitoring.
